description: This Go source file defines validators for conditional validation tags, specifically 'k8s:ifEnabled' and 'k8s:ifDisabled', used within Kubernetes code generation to conditionally apply validations based on options.

classes.name: ifTagValidator
classes.description: A validator struct that handles 'k8s:ifEnabled' and 'k8s:ifDisabled' tags, determining applicability based on enabled state and extracting validation functions.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the validator with configuration, setting the TagValidationExtractor.

methods.name: TagName
methods.description: Returns the tag name ('k8s:ifEnabled' or 'k8s:ifDisabled') based on the enabled flag.

methods.name: ValidScopes
methods.description: Returns the set of valid scopes for the validation tags.

methods.name: GetValidations
methods.description: Extracts validation functions from the tag and constructs validation rules conditioned on the option being enabled or disabled.

methods.name: Docs
methods.description: Generates documentation for the validation tags, including description, args, scopes, and payloads.
